newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Chevalier Group unit signs HK$1.35 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: HK's Chevalier Group unit signs HK$1.35 bln loan.

text.p: Good Process Ltd, a unit of Chevalier Group, has signed a HK$1.35 billion term loan facility to finance the development of a private sector participation scheme project in Tuen Mun, the company said Friday.
The development has a site area of 397,630 square feet and gross floor area of 1.92 million square feet and consists of 3,020 residential units in 12 tower blocks.
The project is scheduled for completion in mid-1999.
A total of seven international banks joined the syndication.

They are Banque Nationale de Paris's Hongkong branch, Sakura Bank, Fuji Bank, Sanwa Bank's Hongkong branch, China Construction Bank's Hongkong branch, Sumitomo Bank's Hongkong branch and Tokai Bank's Hongkong branch.
